```py
function initPanels() {

function completeSwapOperation() {

    var b = m_activePanel.rcTeams.getSelectedIndex() + draft32PanelOffset(m_activePanel);
    if (a != b) {

}
''',
        'navigateUp': r'''
function navigateUp() {
    if (m_activePanel.rcTeams.getSelectedIndex() != 0) {
        m_activePanel.rcTeams.previous();
    } else {
        if (m_arrTeamIDs.length > MAX_TEAMS_PER_PANEL) {

function navigateDown() {
    if (m_activePanel.rcTeams.getSelectedIndex() != getPanelLastIndex(m_activePanel)) {
        m_activePanel.rcTeams.next();

        if (m_arrTeamIDs.length > MAX_TEAMS_PER_PANEL) {
            switchActivePanel(1);

        m_activePanel.rcTeams.setSelectedIndex(0);

        'navigateLeftRight': r'''
function navigateLeftRight(dir) {
    if (!(m_arrTeamIDs.length > MAX_TEAMS_PER_PANEL)) {
        return;
    }
    var idx = m_activePanel.rcTeams.getSelectedIndex();
    switchActivePanel(dir);
    var last = getPanelLastIndex(m_activePanel);
    if (idx > last) {
        m_activePanel.rcTeams.setSelectedIndex(last);
    } else {
        m_activePanel.rcTeams.setSelectedIndex(idx);

    _global.playSound(_global.GameServices.eSoundEvent.IMMEDIATE_MOVE_CURSOR);
}
''',

    m_activePanel = draft32NextPanel(m_activePanel, dir);
    m_activePanel.mcHighlight._visible = true;
}
''',

function getPanelLastIndex(mcPanel) {
    var n = m_arrTeamIDs.length - draft32PanelOffset(mcPanel);
    if (n > MAX_TEAMS_PER_PANEL) {
        n = MAX_TEAMS_PER_PANEL;
    }
    return n - 1;
}
''',
        'localEventHandler': r'''
function localEventHandler(keyCode, controllerId) {
    if (keyCode === _global.INPUTCODE.UI_UP) {
        navigateUp();
    } else if (keyCode === _global.INPUTCODE.UI_DOWN) {
        navigateDown();
    } else if (keyCode === _global.INPUTCODE.UI_LEFT) {
        navigateLeftRight(-1);
    } else if (keyCode === _global.INPUTCODE.UI_RIGHT) {
        navigateLeftRight(1);
    } else if (keyCode === _global.INPUTCODE.ADVANCE) {
        if (m_selectedTeamPanelIndex == NO_TEAM_SELECTED) {
            advanceScreen();
        }
    } else if (keyCode === _global.INPUTCODE.BACK) {
        if (m_selectedTeamPanelIndex == NO_TEAM_SELECTED) {
            backScreen();
        } else {
            endSwapOperation();
        }
    } else if (keyCode === _global.INPUTCODE.OPTION_LEFT) {
        if (m_selectedTeamPanelIndex == NO_TEAM_SELECTED) {
            randomizeDraftOrder();
        }
    } else if (keyCode === _global.INPUTCODE.OPTION_TOP) {
        _global.playSound(_global.GameServices.eSoundEvent.PRIMARY_SELECT);
        if (m_selectedTeamPanelIndex == NO_TEAM_SELECTED) {
            initSwapOperation();
        } else {
            completeSwapOperation();
        }
    } else if (keyCode === _global.INPUTCODE.SELECT) {
        _global.gHelpManager.ShowHelpPopup();
    }
}
''',
    },
    'splice': [('initGUI_3', 'addItem'), ('randomizeDraftOrder', 'refresh')],
}

def log(*a):
    print(*a, flush=True)


def opt(args, name, default=None):
    return args[args.index(name) + 1] if name in args else default


def p(root, rel):
    return os.path.join(root, *rel.split('/'))


def legacy_src(rel):
    f = P.extracted(rel)
    if not f:
        raise SystemExit(f'нет {rel} в распакованных архивах Legacy ({P.big})')
    return f


def u32(b, o):
    return struct.unpack_from('>I', b, o)[0]


def f32(b, o):
    return struct.unpack_from('>f', b, o)[0]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- правки Apt Data

class Edit:
    """Правки ролика: на месте (той же длины, со сверкой старых байт) и дописанное в конец."""

    def __init__(self, path):
        self.mv, self.consts = feapt.load_movie(path)
        self.apt = self.mv.apt
        self.d = bytearray(self.apt.data)
        self.orig_len = len(self.d)
        self.inplace = []           # (смещение, старые, новые, что)
        self.strings = {}

    def put(self, off, new, what):
        old = bytes(self.d[off:off + len(new)])
        self.d[off:off + len(new)] = new
        self.inplace.append((off, old, bytes(new), what))

    def place(self, owner, name):
        ch = self.apt.chars[owner]
        hits = [it for it in ch.frames[0] if it.po and it.po.name == name]
        if len(hits) != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f'символ {owner}: PlaceObject «{name}» — {len(hits)} шт.')
        return hits[0].po

    def set_matrix(self, po, what, a=None, tx=None):
        if a is not None:
            self.put(po.off + 0x10, struct.pack('>f', a), f'{what}: масштаб x {po.matrix[0]:.4g} → {a:.4g}')
        if tx is not None:
            self.put(po.off + 0x20, struct.pack('>f', tx), f'{what}: x {po.matrix[4]:.5g} → {tx:.5g}')

    def edittext_width(self, ci, xmax, what):
        ch = self.apt.chars[ci]
        if ch.type != 2:
            raise SystemExit(f'символ {ci} не EditText')
        old = f32(self.d, ch.off + 0x18)
        self.put(ch.off + 0x18, struct.pack('>f', xmax), f'EditText {ci} ({what}): ширина поля {old:.5g} → {xmax:g}')

    def align(self):
        while len(self.d) % 4:
            self.d.append(0)

    def add_place(self, owner, src_po, depth, name, tx):
        """Копия PlaceObject src_po (тот же символ и матрица) на глубине depth с именем name и x = tx — в кадр 0."""
        ch = self.apt.chars[owner]
        used = {it.po.depth for it in ch.frames[0] if it.po}
        if depth in used:
            raise SystemExit(f'символ {owner}: глубина {depth} занята')
        rec = bytearray(self.d[src_po.off:src_po.off + 0x40])
        struct.pack_into('>I', rec, 0x08, depth)
        struct.pack_into('>f', rec, 0x20, tx)
        struct.pack_into('>I', rec, 0x34, aptc.put_string(self.d, name, self.strings))
        self.align()
        po_off = len(self.d)
        self.d.extend(rec)
        self.insert_item(owner, 0, po_off, after=src_po.off)
        return po_off

    def frame_table(self, owner):
        ch = self.apt.chars[owner]
        return u32(self.d, ch.off + 0x14)

    def insert_item(self, owner, frame, item_off, after=None):
        """Новый элемент кадра (указатель item_off) — после элемента по смещению after (или в конец)."""
        ft = self.frame_table(owner)
        cnt, arr = u32(self.d, ft + 8 * frame), u32(self.d, ft + 8 * frame + 4)
        ptrs = [u32(self.d, arr + 4 * k) for k in range(cnt)]
        pos = ptrs.index(after) + 1 if after is not None else len(ptrs)
        ptrs.insert(pos, item_off)
        self.align()
        new_arr = len(self.d)
        for q in ptrs:
            self.d.extend(struct.pack('>I', q))
        self.put(ft + 8 * frame, struct.pack('>II', cnt + 1, new_arr), f'символ {owner}, кадр {frame}: элементов {cnt} → {cnt + 1}')

    def code_item(self, owner, frame, kind, sprite=None):
        """Смещение элемента Action (kind 1) или InitAction (kind 8, sprite) кадра и смещение его кода."""
        ch = self.apt.chars[owner]
        hits = [it for it in ch.frames[frame] if it.type == kind and (sprite is None or it.sprite == sprite)]
        if len(hits) != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f'символ {owner}, кадр {frame}: элементов кода {kind} — {len(hits)}')
        it = hits[0]
        return it.off, it.code

    def build(self, out_path):
        big = ph.Bigf(self.mv.big.raw)
        _, packed = self.mv.raw['0']
        big.put('0', ph.refpack_compress(bytes(self.d)) if packed else bytes(self.d))
        data = febg.build_bigf(big)
        febg.FeMovie(data)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)
        open(out_path, 'wb').write(data)
        return data


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- код

SPLICE = {
    # (что вставить после) — образцы команд EA и вставка (своё имя панели подставляется)
    'addItem': ([('PushValueOfVar', '{R}'), ('PushOne', None), ('PushRegister', None), ('GetNamedMember', 'EA_ZONE'),
                 ('GetNamedMember', 'gSTM'), ('CallNamedMethodPop', 'addItem')],
                '_global.EA_ZONE.gSTM.addItem({T});'),
    'refresh': ([('PushZero', None), ('PushValueOfVar', '{R}'), ('GetNamedMember', '{RC}'),
                 ('CallNamedMethodPop', 'refresh')],
                '{T}.{RC}.refresh();'),
}
SPLICE_CLASS = {
    'addItem': ([('PushRegister', 1), ('GetNamedMember', 'mcRight'), ('PushOne', None), ('PushRegister', None),
                 ('GetNamedMember', 'EA_ZONE'), ('GetNamedMember', 'gSTM'), ('CallNamedMethodPop', 'addItem')],
                '_global.EA_ZONE.gSTM.addItem(this.mcThird);'),
    'refresh': ([('PushZero', None), ('PushRegister', 1), ('GetNamedMember', 'mcRight'), ('GetNamedMember', 'rc'),
                 ('CallNamedMethodPop', 'refresh')],
                'this.mcThird.rc.refresh();'),
}


def _fill(text, sc):
    L, R, T = sc['panels']
    return text.replace('{L}', L).replace('{R}', R).replace('{T}', T).replace('{RC}', sc['rc'])


def _pattern(pat, sc):
    return [(nm, _fill(a, sc) if isinstance(a, str) else a) for nm, a in pat]


def top_functions(items):
    """{имя: индекс} функций верхнего уровня блока кадра (DefineFunction2/DefineFunction с именем)."""
    out = {}
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        if it[0] == 'rawfn' and it[1].fname:
            if it[1].fname in out:
                raise SystemExit(f'функция {it[1].fname} определена дважды')
            out[it[1].fname] = i
    return out


def class_methods(items):
    """{метод: индекс rawfn} для «r2.Метод = function …» в InitAction класса."""
    out = {}
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        if it[0] == 'rawfn' and not it[1].fname and i >= 2:
            prev = items[i - 1]
            if prev[0] == 'raw' and prev[1].name in ('PushConstant', 'PushWordConstant') and items[i + 1][0] == 'raw' \
                    and items[i + 1][1].name == 'SetMember':
                out[prev[1].arg] = i
    return out


def splice_in(fn_ins, kind, sc, table, notes):
    pat, src = table[kind]
    a, b = aptc.find_seq(fn_ins.body, _pattern(pat, sc))
    if a < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f'{fn_ins.fname or "метод"}: не нашёл места для вставки «{kind}»')
    a2, _ = aptc.find_seq(fn_ins.body, _pattern(pat, sc), b + 1)
    if a2 >= 0:
        raise SystemExit(f'{fn_ins.fname or "метод"}: место вставки «{kind}» не единственное')
    snippet = aptc.compile_snippet(_fill(src, sc), aptc.fn_regs(fn_ins))
    fn_ins.body[b + 1:b + 1] = snippet
    notes.append(f'  вставка после {fn_ins.body[b][1].name} «{kind}»: {_fill(src, sc)}')


def rebuild_frame_code(ed, sc, notes):
    """Блок кода кадра 0 (Action): функции EA — на месте заменить, общие — добавить, вставки — в свои места."""
    code = sc['code']
    item_off, code_off = ed.code_item(sc['owner'], 0, 1)
    items = aptc.parse_block(bytes(ed.d), code_off, ed.consts)
    funcs = top_functions(items)
    for name, src in code['replace'].items():
        if name not in funcs:
            raise SystemExit(f'{sc["rel"]}: нет функции {name}')
        new = aptc.compile_function(_fill(src, sc))
        if new[1]['name'] != name:
            raise SystemExit(f'{name}: в исходнике другое имя ({new[1]["name"]})')
        items[funcs[name]] = new
        notes.append(f'  заменена {name}')
    for name, kind in code['splice']:
        splice_in(items[funcs[name]][1], kind, sc, SPLICE, notes)
    helpers = _fill(code['helpers'], sc).strip()
    if helpers:
        add = aptc.compile_source(helpers)[:-1]          # без End
        first = 1 if items and items[0][0] == 'raw' and items[0][1].name == 'ConstantPool' else 0
        items[first:first] = add
        notes.append('  добавлены ' + ', '.join(it[1]['name'] for it in add))
    new_off = aptc.assemble(items, ed.d, ed.strings)
    ed.put(item_off + 4, struct.pack('>I', new_off), f'Action кадра 0: код @{code_off:#x} → @{new_off:#x} (пересобран)')
    return code_off, new_off


def rebuild_class_code(ed, sc, notes):
    """InitAction класса Live the Life: методы — на месте, новые — после new_after, вставки."""
    code = sc['code']
    item_off, code_off = ed.code_item(0, 0, 8, sc['class_sprite'])
    items = aptc.parse_block(bytes(ed.d), code_off, ed.consts)
    meths = class_methods(items)
    for name, src in code['methods'].items():
        if name not in meths:
            raise SystemExit(f'{sc["rel"]}: нет метода {name}')
        items[meths[name]] = aptc.compile_function(src)
        notes.append(f'  заменён метод {name}')
    for name, kind in code['splice']:
        splice_in(items[meths[name]][1], kind, sc, SPLICE_CLASS, notes)
    after = meths[code['new_after']] + 1                 # SetMember после функции
    add = aptc.compile_source(code['new'])[:-1]
    items[after + 1:after + 1] = add
    notes.append('  добавлены методы _OnUpdateThirdPanelRow, _OnHighlightThirdPanelRow')
    new_off = aptc.assemble(items, ed.d, ed.strings)
    ed.put(item_off + 8, struct.pack('>I', new_off), f'InitAction спрайта {sc["class_sprite"]}: код @{code_off:#x} → @{new_off:#x}')
    return code_off, new_off


def build_screen(sc, dst):
    src = legacy_src(sc['rel'])
    ed = Edit(src)
    notes = [f'{sc["rel"]} ({sc["what"]}):']
    L, R, T = sc['panels']
    owner = sc['owner']
    po_left, po_right = ed.place(owner, L), ed.place(owner, R)
    base_x = po_left.matrix[4]                        # 152 (у Live the Life в спрайте экрана — 1)
    ed.set_matrix(po_right, f'{R}', tx=base_x + (X_RIGHT - 152))
    ed.add_place(owner, po_right, sc['third_depth'], T, base_x + (X_THIRD - 152))
    notes.append(f'  {T}: новая панель (символ {po_right.char}) x {base_x + (X_THIRD - 152):g}, глубина {sc["third_depth"]}')
    for ci, what in sc['texts'].items():
        # поле начинается с x ряда (178 у имени, 154 у Live the Life) — ширина до края колонки минус 6
        xs = {round(it.po.matrix[4], 2) for ch in ed.apt.chars if ch.type == 5 and ch.frames
              for it in ch.frames[0] if it.po and it.po.char == ci}
        if len(xs) != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f'{sc["rel"]}: EditText {ci} стоит в {len(xs)} местах')
        x0 = xs.pop()
        ed.edittext_width(ci, float(COL_W - x0 - 6), what)
    for hs in sc['highlights']:
        ch = ed.apt.chars[hs]
        hl = [it.po for it in ch.frames[0] if it.po and it.po.name == 'mcHighlight']
        if len(hl) != 1 or abs(hl[0].matrix[0] - HL_SCALE_EA) > 1e-3:
            raise SystemExit(f'{sc["rel"]}: спрайт {hs} — нет полосы mcHighlight ×1,53')
        ed.set_matrix(hl[0], f'спрайт {hs} mcHighlight', a=HL_SCALE)
    if 'class_sprite' in sc:
        old, new = rebuild_class_code(ed, sc, notes)
    else:
        old, new = rebuild_frame_code(ed, sc, notes)
    data = ed.build(dst)
    notes += [f'  {w}' for _, _, _, w in ed.inplace]
    notes.append(f'  Apt Data {ed.orig_len} → {len(ed.d)} байт, файл {len(data)} байт')
    return notes, {'rel': sc['rel'], 'inplace': [(o, a.hex(), b.hex(), w) for o, a, b, w in ed.inplace],
                   'orig_len': ed.orig_len, 'old_code': old, 'new_code': new}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- разбор для просмотра

def review(path, code_off, out_txt):
    mv, consts = feapt.load_movie(path)
    code = feapt.Code(mv.apt.data, consts)
    instrs = code.parse(code_off)
    with open(out_txt, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write('\n'.join(feapt.Decompiler().block(instrs)) + '\n')


def cmd_build(args):
    work = opt(args, '--work', WORK)
    if os.path.isdir(work):
        shutil.rmtree(work)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(work, 'review'))
    lines, meta, built = ['draft32_legacy build: три колонки 15 + 15 + 2'], [], []
    for sc in SCREENS:
        dst = p(work, sc['rel'])
        notes, m = build_screen(sc, dst)
        lines += notes
        meta.append(m)
        built.append(sc['rel'])
        review(dst, m['new_code'], os.path.join(work, 'review', os.path.basename(sc['rel'])[:-4] + '.txt'))
    open(os.path.join(work, 'build.log'), 'w', encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
    json.dump({'screens': meta, 'files': built}, open(os.path.join(work, 'build.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'),
              ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
    for x in lines:
        log(x)
    if '--no-out' not in args:
        to_out = [sc['rel'] for sc in SCREENS if sc.get('out') or '--all' in args]
        old = [x.strip() for x in open(FILES, encoding='utf-8')] if os.path.exists(FILES) else []
        for rel in sorted(set(old) - set(to_out)):
            if rel and os.path.exists(p(P.out, rel)):
                log(f'  !! {rel} остался в out от прошлой сборки — убрать вручную (в Корзину)')
        for rel in to_out:
            d = p(P.out, rel)
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(d), exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(p(work, rel), d)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(FILES), exist_ok=True)
        with open(FILES, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
            f.write(''.join(r + '\n' for r in to_out))
        log(f'→ {P.out}: {len(to_out)} из {len(built)} ({", ".join(os.path.basename(r) for r in to_out)}); '
            f'список — {FILES}')
    else:
        log(f'→ {work} (в out не копировалось: --no-out)')


def cmd_check(args):
    work = args[0] if args and not args[0].startswith('--') else WORK
    meta = json.load(open(os.path.join(work, 'build.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    ok = True
    for m, sc in zip(meta['screens'], SCREENS):
        f = p(work, m['rel'])
        data = open(f, 'rb').read()
        mv = febg.FeMovie(data)
        rt = febg.build_bigf(ph.Bigf(data)) == data
        mvc, consts = feapt.load_movie(f)
        code = feapt.Code(mvc.apt.data, consts)
        nb, err = 0, []
        for t, off in feapt.code_blocks(mvc):
            try:
                code.parse(off)
                nb += 1
            except feapt.AptError as e:
                err.append(f'{t}: {e}')
        orig = febg.FeMovie.load(legacy_src(m['rel']))
        a0, a1 = orig.apt.data, mv.apt.data
        allowed = [(o, o + len(bytes.fromhex(b))) for o, _, b, _ in m['inplace']]
        diffs, k = [], 0
        while k < len(a0):
            if a0[k] != a1[k]:
                s = k
                while k < len(a0) and a0[k] != a1[k]:
                    k += 1
                diffs.append((s, k))
            k += 1
        bad = [x for x in diffs if not any(x[0] >= lo and x[1] <= hi for lo, hi in allowed)]
        other = {n: x for n, x in orig.raw.items() if n != '0'} == {n: x for n, x in mv.raw.items() if n != '0'}
        L, R, T = sc['panels']
        places = {it.po.name: it.po for it in mv.apt.chars[sc['owner']].frames[0] if it.po and it.po.name}
        panel_x = [round(places[n].matrix[4]) for n in (L, R, T) if n in places]
        good = rt and not err and not bad and other and len(panel_x) == 3 and a1[:len(a0)] is not None
        log(f'{m["rel"]}: блоков кода {nb} (разбираются{"" if not err else ", ОШИБКИ " + str(err[:2])}), '
            f'BIGF туда-обратно: {"да" if rt else "НЕТ"}; старая часть Apt Data: отличий {len(diffs)}, все в правках: '
            f'{"да" if not bad else "НЕТ " + str(bad[:3])}; прочие записи BIGF те же: {"да" if other else "НЕТ"}; '
            f'панели x {panel_x}')
        ok = ok and good
    log('ИТОГ: ' + ('всё сходится' if ok else 'ЕСТЬ ОШИБКИ'))
    if not ok:
        sys.exit(1)


def main():
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if not args:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    cmd, rest = args[0], args[1:]
    {'build': cmd_build, 'check': cmd_check}.get(cmd, lambda a: sys.exit(__doc__))(rest)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`tools/fb/bundle.py`:

```py
"""Двоичный манифест бандла в CAS (NHL 24 PS4).

u32 BE размер (остатка), затем LE: u32 магия 0x9D798ED6, totalCount, ebxCount, resCount, chunkCount,
stringsOffset, metaOffset, metaSize (смещения — от конца поля размера, т. е. от +4);
sha1[totalCount]; ebx: (nameOfs, size)[ebx]; res: (nameOfs, size)[res]; resType u32[res];
resMeta 16 Б[res]; resRid u64[res]; chunks: (guid 16 Б, logicalOffset, logicalSize)[chunk];
meta — DbObject (chunkMeta: [{h32, meta}]), строки — имена ebx/res (C-строки).
"""
import struct
import uuid

from . import dbobject

MAGICS = (0x9D798ED6, 0x9D798ED5, 0xED1CEDB8)


def is_manifest(head8):
    if len(head8) < 8:
        return False
    size = struct.unpack(">I", head8[:4])[0]
    magic = struct.unpack("<I", head8[4:8])[0]
    return magic in MAGICS and 0x20 <= size < 0x4000000


def parse(data):
    """data — байты начиная с поля размера (u32 BE)."""
    size = struct.unpack_from(">I", data, 0)[0]
    b = memoryview(data)[4:4 + size]
    (magic, total, nebx, nres, nchunk, str_ofs, meta_ofs, meta_size) = struct.unpack_from("<8I", b, 0)
    p = 32
    sha1 = [bytes(b[p + 20 * i:p + 20 * i + 20]).hex() for i in range(total)]
    p += 20 * total

    def cstr(ofs):
        s = bytes(b[str_ofs + ofs:str_ofs + ofs + 512])
        return s[:s.index(b"\0")].decode("utf-8", "replace")

    ebx = []
    for i in range(nebx):
        no, sz = struct.unpack_from("<II", b, p)
        p += 8
        ebx.append({"name": cstr(no), "size": sz, "sha1": sha1[i]})
    res = []
    for i in range(nres):
        no, sz = struct.unpack_from("<II", b, p)
        p += 8
        res.append({"name": cstr(no), "size": sz, "sha1": sha1[nebx + i]})
    for i in range(nres):
        res[i]["type"] = struct.unpack_from("<I", b, p)[0]
        p += 4
    for i in range(nres):
        res[i]["meta"] = bytes(b[p:p + 16])
        p += 16
    for i in range(nres):
        res[i]["rid"] = struct.unpack_from("<Q", b, p)[0]
        p += 8
    chunks = []
    for i in range(nchunk):
        g = uuid.UUID(bytes_le=bytes(b[p:p + 16]))
        lo, ls = struct.unpack_from("<II", b, p + 16)
        p += 24
        chunks.append({"id": str(g), "logical_offset": lo, "logical_size": ls,
                       "sha1": sha1[nebx + nres + i]})
    meta = None
    if meta_size:
        try:
            meta = dbobject.loads(bytes(b[meta_ofs:meta_ofs + meta_size]))
        except Exception:
            meta = None
    return {"magic": magic, "size": size + 4, "ebx": ebx, "res": res, "chunks": chunks, "meta": meta}

```

`tools/fb/cas.py`:

```py
"""Чтение блочно-сжатых данных CAS (Frostbite 2019+, NHL 24 PS4).

Заголовок блока (8 байт): u32 BE распакованный размер (старший байт — флаги),
u8 тип сжатия, u8 флаги (младшая тетрада — биты 16..19 сжатого размера), u16 BE сжатый размер.
Типы: 0x00 без сжатия, 0x02 zlib, 0x09 LZ4, 0x0F ZStd, 0x11/0x15/0x19 Oodle (у NHL 24 — Kraken).
Oodle распаковывает ooz (powzix/ooz, GPL-3.0), собранный локально: tools/fb/build_ooz.cmd.
"""
import ctypes
import os
import struct
import zlib

REPO = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", ".."))
OOZ_DLL = os.path.join(REPO, "game", "work", "nhl24", "bin", "ooz.dll")
_ooz = None


def _oodle():
    global _ooz
    if _ooz is None:
        _ooz = ctypes.CDLL(OOZ_DLL)
        _ooz.ooz_kraken_decompress.restype = ctypes.c_int
        _ooz.ooz_kraken_decompress.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
    return _ooz


def oodle_decompress(src, out_size):
    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(out_size + 64)
    n = _oodle().ooz_kraken_decompress(bytes(src), len(src), buf, out_size)
    if n != out_size:
        raise ValueError(f"Oodle: распаковано {n} из {out_size}")
    return buf.raw[:out_size]


def parse_block_header(h):
    usize, ctype, flags, csize = struct.unpack(">IBBH", h)
    csize |= (flags & 0x0F) << 16
    return usize & 0x00FFFFFF, usize >> 24, ctype, flags, csize


def decompress_block(ctype, usize, payload):
    t = ctype & 0x7F
    if t == 0x00:
        return bytes(payload[:usize])
    if t in (0x11, 0x15, 0x19):
        return oodle_decompress(payload, usize)
    if t == 0x0F:
        import zstandard
        return zstandard.ZstdDecompressor().decompress(bytes(payload), max_output_size=usize)
    if t == 0x02:
        return zlib.decompress(bytes(payload))
    raise ValueError(f"неизвестный тип сжатия 0x{ctype:02x}")


def block_iter(f, offset, end=None):
    """Идёт по блокам с offset: (pos, usize, ctype, csize). Останавливается на мусорном заголовке."""
    pos = offset
    while end is None or pos < end:
        f.seek(pos)
        h = f.read(8)
        if len(h) < 8:
            return
        usize, uflags, ctype, flags, csize = parse_block_header(h)
        if usize == 0 or usize > 0x100000 or (flags & 0xF0) != 0x70:
            return
        yield pos, usize, ctype, csize
        pos += 8 + (usize if (ctype & 0x7F) == 0 else csize)


def read_entry(f, offset, size):
    """Распаковывает поток блоков с offset, пока не наберётся size байт. -> (data, конец потока в CAS)."""
    out = bytearray()
    pos = offset
    while len(out) < size:
        f.seek(pos)
        h = f.read(8)
        usize, uflags, ctype, flags, csize = parse_block_header(h)
        n = usize if (ctype & 0x7F) == 0 else csize
        payload = f.read(n)
        out += decompress_block(ctype, usize, payload)
        pos += 8 + n
    return bytes(out[:size]), pos


def read_stored(f, offset, csize):
    """Распаковать все блоки сохранённого потока [offset, offset+csize) (место из TOC)."""
    out = bytearray()
    pos, end = offset, offset + csize
    while pos + 8 <= end:
        f.seek(pos)
        h = f.read(8)
        usize, uflags, ctype, flags, cs = parse_block_header(h)
        n = usize if (ctype & 0x7F) == 0 else cs
        out += decompress_block(ctype, usize, f.read(n))
        pos += 8 + n
    return bytes(out)


```

`tools/fb/catalog.py`:

```py
"""Сводка по результатам fb.scan: типы res, текстуры, чанки; группы по путям.

  python -m fb.catalog            -> game/work/nhl24/catalog/{restypes.csv,textures.csv,prefixes.csv,chunks.idx.json}
"""
import collections
import csv
import glob
import json
import os
import sys

from .cas import REPO
from .texture import RES_TEXTURE

CAT = os.path.join(REPO, "game", "work", "nhl24", "catalog")


def records():
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(CAT, "scan", "*.jsonl"))):
        with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                yield json.loads(line)


def load():
    tex, chunks, ebx = [], {}, []
    rtypes = collections.Counter()
    rexample = {}
    for r in records():
        k = r["k"]
        if k == "res":
            rtypes[r["type"]] += 1
            rexample.setdefault(r["type"], r["name"])
            if r["type"] == RES_TEXTURE:
                tex.append(r)
        elif k == "chunk":
            c = chunks.setdefault(r["id"], [])
            c.append(r)
        elif k == "ebx":
            ebx.append(r)
    return tex, chunks, ebx, rtypes, rexample


def main():
    tex, chunks, ebx, rtypes, rexample = load()
    os.makedirs(CAT, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(CAT, "restypes.csv"), "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(["type", "count", "example"])
        for t, n in rtypes.most_common():
            w.writerow([f"0x{t:08x}", n, rexample[t]])
    with open(os.path.join(CAT, "textures.csv"), "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(["name", "bundle", "cas", "ofs", "csize", "size", "missing"])
        for r in sorted(tex, key=lambda r: r["name"]):
            w.writerow([r["name"], r["b"], r.get("cas", ""), r.get("ofs", ""), r.get("csize", ""), r["size"], r.get("missing", 0)])
    pref = collections.Counter()
    for r in tex:
        parts = r["name"].split("/")
        for d in (2, 3, 4):
            if len(parts) > d:
                pref["/".join(parts[:d])] += 1
    with open(os.path.join(CAT, "prefixes.csv"), "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(["prefix", "textures"])
        for p, n in sorted(pref.items()):
            w.writerow([p, n])
    idx = {}
    for cid, lst in chunks.items():
        have = [c for c in lst if "ofs" in c]
        c = have[0] if have else lst[0]
        idx[cid] = {k: c.get(k) for k in ("cas", "ofs", "csize", "lo", "ls", "sha1", "h32")}
        idx[cid]["missing"] = 0 if have else 1
    with open(os.path.join(CAT, "chunks.idx.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(idx, f)
    names = {r["name"] for r in tex}
    print(f"res-типов {len(rtypes)}, текстур {len(tex)} (уникальных имён {len(names)}), "
          f"чанков {len(chunks)} (без места {sum(v['missing'] for v in idx.values())}), ebx {len(ebx)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

`tools/fb/dbobject.py`:

```py
"""DbObject — двоичный формат Frostbite для TOC/initfs/meta бандлов.

Байт типа: младшие 5 бит — тип, бит 0x80 — «без имени» (элемент списка/корень).
Типы: 0x01 list, 0x02 object, 0x06 bool, 0x07 string, 0x08 int32, 0x09 int64,
0x0B float, 0x0C double, 0x0F guid, 0x10 sha1, 0x13 bytes. 0x00 — конец списка/объекта.
"""
import struct
import uuid


def read_varint(buf, pos):
    val = 0
    shift = 0
    while True:
        b = buf[pos]
        pos += 1
        val |= (b & 0x7F) << shift
        if not b & 0x80:
            return val, pos
        shift += 7


def _read_cstr(buf, pos):
    end = buf.index(b"\0", pos)
    return buf[pos:end].decode("utf-8", "replace"), end + 1


def read_value(buf, pos):
    """Читает один элемент: возвращает (name, value, pos). На 0x00 — (None, StopIteration, pos)."""
    t = buf[pos]
    pos += 1
    if t == 0:
        return None, StopIteration, pos
    name = None
    if not t & 0x80:
        name, pos = _read_cstr(buf, pos)
    t &= 0x1F
    if t == 0x01 or t == 0x02:
        size, pos = read_varint(buf, pos)
        end = pos + size
        if t == 0x01:
            out = []
            while pos < end:
                _, v, pos = read_value(buf, pos)
                if v is StopIteration:
                    break
                out.append(v)
        else:
            out = {}
            while pos < end:
                n, v, pos = read_value(buf, pos)
                if v is StopIteration:
                    break
                out[n] = v
        return name, out, end
    if t == 0x06:
        return name, bool(buf[pos]), pos + 1
    if t == 0x07:
        n, pos = read_varint(buf, pos)
        return name, buf[pos:pos + n].rstrip(b"\0").decode("utf-8", "replace"), pos + n
    if t == 0x08:
        return name, struct.unpack_from("<i", buf, pos)[0], pos + 4
    if t == 0x09:
        return name, struct.unpack_from("<q", buf, pos)[0], pos + 8
    if t == 0x0B:
        return name, struct.unpack_from("<f", buf, pos)[0], pos + 4
    if t == 0x0C:
        return name, struct.unpack_from("<d", buf, pos)[0], pos + 8
    if t == 0x0F:
        return name, uuid.UUID(bytes_le=bytes(buf[pos:pos + 16])), pos + 16
    if t == 0x10:
        return name, bytes(buf[pos:pos + 20]).hex(), pos + 20
    if t == 0x13:
        n, pos = read_varint(buf, pos)
        return name, bytes(buf[pos:pos + n]), pos + n
    raise ValueError(f"DbObject: неизвестный тип 0x{t:02x} @0x{pos - 1:x}")


def loads(buf, pos=0):
    _, v, _ = read_value(buf, pos)
    return v


TOC_HEADER = 0x22C  # магия 00D1CE01 + подпись + строка-ключ «x…x»; дальше — открытые данные


def strip_toc_header(data):
    """Снимает заголовок 00D1CE0x (подпись), если есть. В NHL 24 данные после 0x22C не XOR-ены."""
    if data[:3] == b"\x00\xd1\xce" and data[3] in (0, 1, 3):
        return data[TOC_HEADER:]
    return data

```

`tools/fb/extract.py`:

```py
"""Выгрузка текстур NHL 24 в PNG по регулярке имени (после fb.scan + fb.catalog).

  python -m fb.extract REGEX [--out ПАПКА] [--mip N] [--limit N] [--list]
PNG кладутся в game/work/nhl24/extract/<ПАПКА>/<путь res без content/>.png,
отчёт — <ПАПКА>/_index.csv (имя, формат, размер, мипы, чанк, статус).
"""
import argparse
import csv
import json
import os
import re
import sys

from . import cas, texture
from .cas import REPO

DATA = os.path.join(REPO, "game", "other", "nhl24", "Data", "Gen4b", "superbundlelayout")
WORK = os.path.join(REPO, "game", "work", "nhl24")
CAT = os.path.join(WORK, "catalog")

_files = {}
_chunks = None
VERIFY = True  # сверять sha1 чанка перед распаковкой


def cas_path(key):
    ip, c = key.split("/")
    return os.path.join(DATA, "nhl_installpackage_" + ip[2:], c + ".cas")


def cas_file(key):
    f = _files.get(key)
    if f is None:
        f = _files[key] = open(cas_path(key), "rb")
    return f


def chunks():
    """GUID чанка -> место в CAS: сразу за манифестом (fb.catalog) или найденное по sha1 (fb.orphans)."""
    global _chunks
    if _chunks is None:
        with open(os.path.join(CAT, "chunks.idx.json"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
            _chunks = json.load(f)
        om = os.path.join(CAT, "orphan_map.json")
        if os.path.exists(om):
            with open(om, encoding="utf-8") as f:
                found = json.load(f)
            by_sha = {}
            for cid, c in _chunks.items():
                if not c.get("missing"):
                    by_sha[c["sha1"]] = c
            for cid, loc in found.items():
                c = _chunks.get(cid)
                if c:
                    c.update(cas=loc["cas"], ofs=loc["ofs"], csize=loc["csize"], missing=0, orphan=1,
                             stored=loc.get("size"))
                    by_sha[c["sha1"]] = c
            for cid, c in _chunks.items():  # те же байты под другим GUID
                if c.get("missing") and c["sha1"] in by_sha:
                    src = by_sha[c["sha1"]]
                    c.update(cas=src["cas"], ofs=src["ofs"], csize=src["csize"], missing=0, orphan=1,
                             stored=src.get("stored"))
        tp = os.path.join(CAT, "toc_chunks.json")
        if os.path.exists(tp):  # оглавления (.toc): точное место каждого чанка — главнее догадок прохода без TOC
            with open(tp, encoding="utf-8") as f:
                toc = json.load(f)
            for cid, t in toc.items():
                c = _chunks.get(cid)
                rec = {"cas": t["cas"], "ofs": t["ofs"], "csize": t["csize"], "missing": 0, "toc": 1,
                       "toc_sha1": t.get("sha1")}  # sha1 есть только у мест из записей бандлов (поток бандла)
                if c is None:
                    rec.update(lo=t.get("lo"), ls=t.get("ls"), sha1=t.get("sha1"))
                    _chunks[cid] = rec
                elif c.get("lo") and c.get("orphan") and c.get("stored") == (c.get("lo") or 0) + c["ls"]:
                    continue  # уже есть целый поток (найден по sha1, с мипом 0) — лучше хвоста из записи бандла
                else:
                    c.update(rec)
                    c.pop("stored", None)
    return _chunks


def textures(regex):
    rx = re.compile(regex)
    seen = {}
    with open(os.path.join(CAT, "textures.csv"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in csv.DictReader(f):
            if rx.search(r["name"]) and r["ofs"] and r["name"] not in seen:
                seen[r["name"]] = r
    return list(seen.values())


def read_header(r):
    d, _ = cas.read_entry(cas_file(r["cas"]), int(r["ofs"]), int(r["size"]))
    return texture.parse_header(d)


def read_chunk(h):
    """-> (данные, номер мипа, с которого они начинаются) или (None, 0).

    Место — из оглавлений (.toc), если есть: тогда читается весь сохранённый поток [ofs, ofs+csize) и по его длине
    понятно, целый это чанк или только хвост мипов с first_mip. Без TOC — как раньше (sha1-сверка мест прохода)."""
    c = chunks().get(h["chunk"])
    if not c or c.get("missing"):
        return None, 0
    if c.get("toc"):
        d = cas.read_stored(cas_file(c["cas"]), c["ofs"], c["csize"])
        full = sum(h["mip_sizes"])
        tail = sum(h["mip_sizes"][h["first_mip"]:])
        if c.get("toc_sha1") and not c.get("lo") and VERIFY:
            # место из записи бандла — сверка с sha1 манифеста; у частичного чанка (lo > 0) запись TOC указывает на
            # хвост внутри потока, а sha1 манифеста — от всего потока, так что там не сверяем
            import hashlib
            f = cas_file(c["cas"])
            f.seek(c["ofs"])
            if hashlib.sha1(f.read(c["csize"])).hexdigest() != c["toc_sha1"]:
                raise ValueError("sha1 не совпал (место из записи бандла в TOC)")
        if len(d) >= full:
            return d, 0
        if len(d) >= tail:
            return d, h["first_mip"]
        raise ValueError(f"поток {len(d)} Б меньше хвоста мипов {tail} Б")
    lo, ls = c["lo"] or 0, c["ls"]
    stored = c.get("stored") or (ls if (lo and not c.get("orphan")) else lo + ls)
    if VERIFY and c.get("csize"):
        # проход без TOC мог перепутать два чанка одного размера в бандле (свой лежит не здесь, а здесь — соседний):
        # сверка sha1 сжатых байт с манифестом
        import hashlib
        f = cas_file(c["cas"])
        f.seek(c["ofs"])
        if hashlib.sha1(f.read(c["csize"])).hexdigest() != c["sha1"]:
            raise ValueError("sha1 не совпал: на этом месте чужой чанк (перепутан при проходе без TOC)")
    d, _ = cas.read_entry(cas_file(c["cas"]), c["ofs"], stored)
    start = 0
    if lo and stored == ls:
        start = h["first_mip"]
    return d, start


def out_name(name):
    return name[len("content/"):] if name.startswith("content/") else name


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("regex")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="misc")
    ap.add_argument("--mip", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--list", action="store_true", help="только заголовки, без PNG")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    rows = textures(a.regex)
    if a.limit:
        rows = rows[:a.limit]
    base = os.path.join(WORK, "extract", a.out)
    os.makedirs(base, exist_ok=True)
    idx = []
    ok = miss = bad = 0
    for r in rows:
        h = read_header(r)
        rec = {"name": r["name"], "format": texture.format_name(h["format"]), "w": h["width"], "h": h["height"],
               "mips": h["mips"], "slices": h["slices"], "group": h["group"], "chunk": h["chunk"], "status": ""}
        if a.list:
            c = chunks().get(h["chunk"])
            rec["status"] = "missing" if (not c or c.get("missing")) else "ok"
            idx.append(rec)
            continue
        try:
            data, start = read_chunk(h)
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            data, start = None, 0
            rec["status"] = f"error: {e}"
        if data is None and rec["status"]:
            bad += 1
        elif data is None:
            rec["status"] = "missing"
            miss += 1
        else:
            try:
                lvl = min(max(a.mip, start), max(h["mips"] - 1, 0))
                img = texture.decode_mip(h, data, lvl, data_first=start)
                p = os.path.join(base, out_name(r["name"]) + ".png")
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
                img.save(p)
                rec["status"] = "ok"
                rec["png"] = os.path.relpath(p, base)
                ok += 1
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                rec["status"] = f"error: {e}"
                bad += 1
        idx.append(rec)
    with open(os.path.join(base, "_index.csv"), "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["name", "format", "w", "h", "mips", "slices", "group", "chunk", "status", "png"])
        w.writeheader()
        for rec in idx:
            w.writerow(rec)
    st = {}
    for rec in idx:
        st[rec["status"].split(":")[0]] = st.get(rec["status"].split(":")[0], 0) + 1
    print(f"{len(idx)} текстур: {st} -> {base}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tools/fb/fonts.py`:

```py
"""Шрифты номеров NHL 24 → NHL Legacy (font_cm/nm/sm 512²) для 32 клубов. Только офлайн.

Атлас NHL 24 (font_adidas_<клуб>_<форма>_color, 1024²) — та же раскладка, что у EA в Legacy (512²): ячейки букв,
больших и малых цифр, C/A — на тех же местах (проверено czkit.font_cells: M/N/O и цифры совпадают; лишние «´» и «.»
у NHL 24 стоят в пустых промежутках раскладки EA). Поэтому перенос — уменьшение 1024 → 512:
  font_cm — цвет с альфой (уменьшение с премультипликацией альфы);
  font_nm — из font_*_normal NHL 24 (BC5: X, Y; Z = √(1 − X² − Y²)), R = X, G = Y, как ждёт kitpaint pack;
  font_sm — как у EA: серый 21 с альфой 0/255 по глифам.
Сравнение с нынешним шрифтом Legacy этой формы (kitpaint unpack 1_<art>_<вариант> --game legacy): IoU масок глифов
цифр и разница цвета заливки; «отличается» — IoU < 0,85 или цвет дальше 30.

  python -m fb.fonts build      -> game/work/nhl24/out/kits/<КОД>_<форма>/font_{cm,nm,sm}.png, out/fonts.json
  python -m fb.fonts sheet      -> game/work/nhl24/compare/fonts_32.png
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

from .cas import REPO
from .kit_batch import CLUBS, KITS, legacy_target

NHL24 = os.path.join(REPO, "game", "work", "nhl24")
SRC = os.path.join(NHL24, "extract", "fonts24", "character", "skater", "league", "nhl")
OUT = os.path.join(NHL24, "out", "kits")
LEG = os.path.join(NHL24, "out", "_legacy_kits")
DIGITS = (0, 98, 405, 368)        # большие цифры (x0, y0, x1, y1) на 512²


def resize_premult(rgba, size):
    a = rgba[..., 3:4] / 255.0
    pre = np.concatenate([rgba[..., :3] * a, rgba[..., 3:4]], -1).astype(np.float32)
    ch = [np.asarray(Image.fromarray(pre[..., k]).resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)) for k in range(4)]
    out = np.stack(ch, -1)
    al = np.clip(out[..., 3:4], 0, 255)
    rgb = np.where(al > 0.5, out[..., :3] / np.maximum(al / 255.0, 1e-3), 0)
    return np.clip(np.concatenate([rgb, al], -1), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)


def normal_map(path, size):
    n = np.asarray(Image.open(path).convert("RGB")).astype(np.float32) / 255.0 * 2 - 1
    x, y = n[..., 0], n[..., 1]
    z = np.sqrt(np.clip(1 - x * x - y * y, 0, 1))
    rgb = (np.stack([x, y, z], -1) + 1) * 127.5
    im = Image.fromarray(np.clip(rgb, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)).resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)
    return np.dstack([np.asarray(im), np.full((size, size), 255, np.uint8)])


def legacy_font(art, variant):
    kit = f"1_{art}_{variant}"
    d = os.path.join(LEG, kit)
    p = os.path.join(d, "font_cm.png")
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(REPO, "tools", "kitpaint.py"), "unpack", kit, d, "--game", "legacy"],
                       check=False, capture_output=True, cwd=os.path.join(REPO, "tools"))
    return np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert("RGBA")) if os.path.exists(p) else None


def compare(new, cur):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = DIGITS
    a = new[y0:y1, x0:x1, 3] > 128
    b = cur[y0:y1, x0:x1, 3] > 128
    iou = (a & b).sum() / max((a | b).sum(), 1)
    fa = new[y0:y1, x0:x1][new[y0:y1, x0:x1, 3] > 230][:, :3]
    fb = cur[y0:y1, x0:x1][cur[y0:y1, x0:x1, 3] > 230][:, :3]
    dc = float(np.linalg.norm(np.median(fa, 0) - np.median(fb, 0))) if len(fa) and len(fb) else 999.0
    return round(float(iou), 3), round(dc, 1)


def cmd_build(a):
    from .kit_batch import ok_names
    ok = ok_names(os.path.join(NHL24, "extract", "fonts24"))
    res = []
    for club, art, code in CLUBS:
        for kit, loc in KITS.items():
            rec = {"code": code, "kit": kit}
            cp = os.path.join(SRC, club, "adidas", kit, f"font_adidas_{club}_{kit}_color.png")
            npth = os.path.join(SRC, club, "adidas", kit, f"font_adidas_{club}_{kit}_normal.png")
            tgt = legacy_target(art, loc)
            if not os.path.exists(os.path.dirname(cp)):
                rec["status"] = "нет комплекта в NHL 24"
                res.append(rec)
                continue
            base_name = f"content/character/skater/league/nhl/{club}/adidas/{kit}/font_adidas_{club}_{kit}_"
            if base_name + "color" not in ok:
                rec["status"] = "нет чанка" if not os.path.exists(cp) else "нет чанка (на месте чужой, sha1)"
                res.append(rec)
                continue
            if base_name + "normal" not in ok:
                npth = None
            cm = resize_premult(np.asarray(Image.open(cp).convert("RGBA")), 512)
            nm = normal_map(npth, 512) if npth and os.path.exists(npth) else None
            if nm is None:  # нормали NHL 24 нет — плоская (как у шрифтов EA: почти плоская)
                nm = np.zeros((512, 512, 4), np.uint8)
                nm[...] = (128, 128, 255, 255)
                rec["nm"] = "плоская (нормаль NHL 24 не найдена)"
            sm = np.zeros((512, 512, 4), np.uint8)
            sm[..., :3] = 21
            sm[..., 3] = np.where(cm[..., 3] > 128, 255, 0)
            od = os.path.join(OUT, f"{code}_{kit}")
            os.makedirs(od, exist_ok=True)
            Image.fromarray(cm).save(os.path.join(od, "font_cm.png"))
            Image.fromarray(sm).save(os.path.join(od, "font_sm.png"))
            if nm is not None:
                Image.fromarray(nm).save(os.path.join(od, "font_nm.png"))
            rec["status"] = "ok"
            if tgt:
                rec["legacy"] = f"texlib_1_{art}_{tgt['variant']}: font_1_{art}_{tgt['variant']}_cm/nm/sm"
                cur = legacy_font(art, tgt["variant"])
                if cur is not None:
                    iou, dc = compare(cm, cur)
                    rec.update(iou=iou, color_diff=dc, differs=bool(iou < 0.85 or dc > 30))
            else:
                rec["legacy"] = "нет строки Legacy (стиль 1)"
            res.append(rec)
            print(code, kit, rec.get("status"), rec.get("iou"), rec.get("color_diff"),
                  "ОТЛИЧАЕТСЯ" if rec.get("differs") else "", flush=True)
    with open(os.path.join(NHL24, "out", "fonts.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(res, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)


def cmd_sheet(a):
    try:
        font = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeuib.ttf", 17)
        small = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeui.ttf", 14)
    except OSError:
        font = small = ImageFont.load_default()
    with open(os.path.join(NHL24, "out", "fonts.json"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        res = {(r["code"], r["kit"]): r for r in json.load(f)}
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = DIGITS
    cw, chh = 210, int(210 * (y1 - y0) / (x1 - x0))
    cols = 2
    row_h = chh + 40
    lw = 70
    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (cols * (lw + 4 * (cw + 6)) + 10, ((len(CLUBS) + cols - 1) // cols) * row_h + 40),
                      (30, 30, 34))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for c in range(cols):
        d.text((10 + c * (lw + 4 * (cw + 6)) + lw, 8), "home: Legacy | NHL 24", fill=(235, 235, 235), font=font)
        d.text((10 + c * (lw + 4 * (cw + 6)) + lw + 2 * (cw + 6), 8), "away: Legacy | NHL 24", fill=(235, 235, 235),
               font=font)

    def tile(img):
        bg = np.zeros_like(img[y0:y1, x0:x1, :3], dtype=np.float64)
        bg[:] = 110
        al = img[y0:y1, x0:x1, 3:4] / 255.0
        t = (bg * (1 - al) + img[y0:y1, x0:x1, :3] * al).astype(np.uint8)
        return Image.fromarray(t).resize((cw, chh), Image.LANCZOS)

    for i, (club, art, code) in enumerate(CLUBS):
        c, r = i % cols, i // cols
        x = 10 + c * (lw + 4 * (cw + 6))
        y = 36 + r * row_h
        d.text((x, y + chh // 2 - 8), code, fill=(235, 235, 235), font=font)
        for j, kit in enumerate(("home", "away")):
            rec = res.get((code, kit), {})
            xx = x + lw + j * 2 * (cw + 6)
            tgt = legacy_target(art, KITS[kit])
            cur = legacy_font(art, tgt["variant"]) if tgt else None
            if cur is not None:
                sheet.paste(tile(cur), (xx, y))
            p = os.path.join(OUT, f"{code}_{kit}", "font_cm.png")
            if rec.get("status") == "ok" and os.path.exists(p):  # только проверенные (sha1) — не старые файлы
                sheet.paste(tile(np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert("RGBA"))), (xx + cw + 6, y))
            else:
                d.text((xx + cw + 20, y + chh // 2 - 8), rec.get("status", "нет"), fill=(220, 130, 130), font=small)
            note = ("отличается" if rec.get("differs") else ("похож" if "iou" in rec else "")) + (
                f"  IoU {rec['iou']}, Δцвет {rec['color_diff']}" if "iou" in rec else "")
            d.text((xx, y + chh + 2), note, fill=(200, 200, 200), font=small)
    out = os.path.join(NHL24, "compare", "fonts_32.png")
    sheet.save(out)
    print(out, sheet.size)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("build")
    sub.add_parser("sheet")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    return {"build": cmd_build, "sheet": cmd_sheet}[a.cmd](a)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

`tools/fb/gallery.py`:

```py
"""Галерея всех комплектов NHL 24 (570 свитеров league/nhl: 32 клуба, All-Star, legends) — для выбора форм.

Рендер на сетке своего кроя NHL 24 (player_jersey_<крой>_notuck_large), спереди и сзади — одна картинка на комплект.
Источник — extract/gallery24 (fb.extract по TOC, со сверкой sha1). Только локально, никуда не публиковать:
ассеты NHL 24 — только для личного использования.

  python -m fb.gallery build     # game/work/nhl24/gallery/<клуб>/<крой>_<комплект>.png, thumbs/, index.html
  python -m fb.gallery index     # только index.html (по уже готовым картинкам)
"""
import argparse
import csv
import html
import json
import os
import re
import sys

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

from . import kit3d
from .cas import REPO
from .kit_batch import CLUBS

NHL24 = os.path.join(REPO, "game", "work", "nhl24")
SRC = os.path.join(NHL24, "extract", "gallery24")
OUT = os.path.join(NHL24, "gallery")
RX = re.compile(r"^content/character/skater/league/nhl/([a-z0-9]+)/([a-z0-9]+)/([a-z0-9]+)/jersey_\2_\1_\3_color$")
MESH = "content/character/skater/player/jersey/{cut}/components/player_jersey_{cut}_notuck_large_lod0_mesh"
CUTS = {"adidas": "adidas (с 2017)", "rbk": "Reebok Edge (2007–2017)", "nineties": "90-е"}
CUT_ORDER = ("adidas", "rbk", "nineties")
KIT_NAMES = {"home": "домашняя", "away": "выездная", "three": "третья", "two": "альтернативная 2",
             "four": "альтернативная 4", "five": "альтернативная 5", "six": "альтернативная 6",
             "seven": "альтернативная 7", "eight": "альтернативная 8", "nine": "альтернативная 9",
             "twentytwo": "Reverse Retro 2022", "twentythree": "Reverse Retro 2023"}
KIT_ORDER = ("home", "away", "three", "two", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "twentytwo", "twentythree")
SPECIAL = {"atlantic": "All-Star: Atlantic", "central": "All-Star: Central", "metropolitan": "All-Star: Metropolitan",
           "pacific": "All-Star: Pacific", "east": "All-Star: East", "west": "All-Star: West", "legends": "Legends"}
NOTE = {"ARI": "ARI → Utah, в пакет не идёт"}
VIEW_W = 420


def kits():
    """[{club, cut, kit, name, status, png}] — по _index.csv выгрузки (все 570 jersey_*_color league/nhl)."""
    out = []
    with open(os.path.join(SRC, "_index.csv"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in csv.DictReader(f):
            m = RX.match(r["name"])
            if m:
                out.append({"club": m.group(1), "cut": m.group(2), "kit": m.group(3), "name": r["name"],
                            "status": r["status"], "png": os.path.join(SRC, r["png"]) if r.get("png") else None})
    return out


def club_label(folder):
    code = {c: k for c, _a, k in CLUBS}.get(folder)
    return (code or SPECIAL.get(folder, folder)), code


def club_order(folders):
    nhl = sorted([f for f in folders if f not in SPECIAL], key=lambda f: club_label(f)[0])
    return nhl + [f for f in SPECIAL if f in folders]


def kit_key(k):
    return (CUT_ORDER.index(k["cut"]) if k["cut"] in CUT_ORDER else 9,
            KIT_ORDER.index(k["kit"]) if k["kit"] in KIT_ORDER else 99, k["kit"])


def file_of(k):
    return f"{k['cut']}_{k['kit']}.png"


def cmd_build(a):
    try:
        f_b = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeuib.ttf", 20)
        f_r = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeui.ttf", 16)
    except OSError:
        f_b = f_r = ImageFont.load_default()
    meshes = {}
    allk = kits()
    done = bad = 0
    for k in sorted(allk, key=lambda k: (k["club"],) + kit_key(k)):
        odir = os.path.join(OUT, k["club"])
        dst = os.path.join(odir, file_of(k))
        if k["status"] != "ok" or not k["png"] or not os.path.exists(k["png"]):
            bad += 1
            continue
        if os.path.exists(dst) and not a.force:
            done += 1
            continue
        cut = k["cut"]
        if cut not in meshes:
            meshes[cut] = kit3d.load_nhl24(MESH.format(cut=cut))
        tex = kit3d.load_tex(k["png"], 1024)
        views = [kit3d.render(meshes[cut], tex, v, VIEW_W, frame=kit3d.FRAME, ss=2) for v in ("front", "back")]
        lbl, code = club_label(k["club"])
        cap = f"{lbl}  ·  {k['club']} / {k['cut']} / {k['kit']}"
        sub = f"{CUTS.get(cut, cut)}, {KIT_NAMES.get(k['kit'], k['kit'])}" + (f"  —  {NOTE[code]}" if code in NOTE else "")
        W = VIEW_W * 2 + 30
        H = views[0].size[1] + 64
        im = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (30, 30, 34))
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
        d.text((10, 6), cap, fill=(240, 240, 240), font=f_b)
        d.text((10, 32), sub, fill=(200, 200, 200), font=f_r)
        for i, v in enumerate(views):
            im.paste(v, (10 + i * (VIEW_W + 10), 58))
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(odir, "thumbs"), exist_ok=True)
        im.save(dst)
        th = Image.new("RGB", (VIEW_W * 2 + 10, views[0].size[1]), (30, 30, 34))
        for i, v in enumerate(views):
            th.paste(v, (i * (VIEW_W + 10), 0))
        th.resize((th.size[0] * 3 // 8, th.size[1] * 3 // 8), Image.LANCZOS).save(os.path.join(odir, "thumbs", file_of(k)))
        done += 1
        if done % 25 == 0:
            print(done, k["club"], k["cut"], k["kit"], flush=True)
    print(f"картинок {done}, без текстуры {bad}")
    cmd_index(a)


PAGE = """<!doctype html>

def cmd_index(a):
    allk = kits()
    by = {}
    for k in allk:
        by.setdefault(k["club"], []).append(k)
    nav, body = [], []
    for folder in club_order(by):
        lbl, code = club_label(folder)
        ks = sorted(by[folder], key=kit_key)
        nav.append(f'<a href="#{folder}">{html.escape(lbl)}</a>')
        note = f' <span class="note">{html.escape(NOTE[code])}</span>' if code in NOTE else ""
        body.append(f'<h2 id="{folder}">{html.escape(lbl)} <small style="color:#888">({folder}, {len(ks)})</small>{note}</h2>')
        for cut in CUT_ORDER + tuple(sorted({k["cut"] for k in ks} - set(CUT_ORDER))):
            cks = [k for k in ks if k["cut"] == cut]
            if not cks:
                continue
            body.append(f"<h3>{html.escape(CUTS.get(cut, cut))}</h3><div class=\"grid\">")
            for k in cks:
                fn = file_of(k)
                cap = (f"<b>{html.escape(folder)} / {html.escape(cut)} / {html.escape(k['kit'])}</b> — "
                       f"{html.escape(KIT_NAMES.get(k['kit'], k['kit']))}")
                if os.path.exists(os.path.join(OUT, folder, fn)):
                    img = (f'<a href="{folder}/{fn}"><img src="{folder}/thumbs/{fn}" data-big="{folder}/{fn}" '
                           f'loading="lazy" alt="{html.escape(fn)}"></a>')
                else:
                    img = f'<div class="miss">нет текстуры ({html.escape(k["status"])})</div>'
                body.append(f"<figure>{img}<figcaption>{cap}</figcaption></figure>")
            body.append("</div>")
    page = PAGE.format(total=len(allk), nav=" ".join(nav), body="\n".join(body))
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, "index.html"), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write(page)
    st = {}
    for k in allk:
        st[k["status"]] = st.get(k["status"], 0) + 1
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, "_summary.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"kits": len(allk), "status": st, "clubs": len(by)}, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
    print(os.path.join(OUT, "index.html"), len(allk), "комплектов", st)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    b = sub.add_parser("build")
    b.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="перерисовать и готовые")
    sub.add_parser("index")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    return {"build": cmd_build, "index": cmd_index}[a.cmd](a)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

`tools/fb/heads.py`:

```py
"""Головы-сканы NHL 24 (PS4): сетки MeshSet и текстуры по имени папки content/character/skater/shared/head/licensed/<папка>.

У всех голов NHL 24 одна сетка `mat_head` (3157 вершин, 6014 треугольников, один порядок вершин и одна развёртка) — та же
базовая голова EA, что у сканов NHL Legacy (head 2623 + mouthbag 534; docs/heads-nhl24.md). Геометрия — в чанке по TOC.

MeshSet головы (тип 0x49B156D4): u64 @0x20 — LOD; LOD+0x08 число секций, +0x0C смещение секций (шаг 0xE0 — у свитера в
meshset.py 0xC0), +0x58/+0x5C — размеры буферов индексов/вершин, +0x60 — GUID чанка, +0x98 — число костей. Секция: +0x08 имя,
+0x20 треугольников, +0x24 первый индекс, +0x28 смещение вершин, +0x2C число вершин, +0x4C — 16 элементов (usage, формат,
смещение, поток), +0x8C — шаги потоков. Usage: 1 позиция, 2/3 индексы костей, 4/5 веса, 6 нормаль, 7 касательная,
8 бинормаль, 0x21/0x22 UV. Форматы: 3 float3, 6 half2, 8 half4, 0x0D ubyte4n, 0x16 ubyte4, 0x17 ushort4.

Только чтение; нужны дамп NHL 24 и каталог (fb.scan, fb.catalog, fb.toc index).
"""
import csv
import os
import re
import struct
import uuid

import numpy as np

from . import cas, texture
from .cas import REPO

CAT = os.path.join(REPO, "game", "work", "nhl24", "catalog")
LICENSED = "content/character/skater/shared/head/licensed"
FMT = {3: ("<f4", 3), 6: ("<f2", 2), 8: ("<f2", 4), 0x0D: ("u1", 4), 0x16: ("u1", 4), 0x17: ("<u2", 4),
       2: ("<f4", 2), 4: ("<f4", 4)}
USAGE = {1: "pos", 2: "bi0", 3: "bi1", 4: "bw0", 5: "bw1", 6: "nrm", 7: "tan", 8: "binrm", 0x21: "uv0", 0x22: "uv1"}
SECTION_STEP = 0xE0

_res = None
_tex = None


def licensed_folders():
    """Папки сканов, у которых в каталоге есть сетка головы head_<папка>_mesh."""
    txt = open(os.path.join(CAT, "meshnames.txt"), encoding="utf-8").read()
    return sorted(set(re.findall(LICENSED + r"/([^/\s]+)/components/head_\1_mesh", txt)))


def _res_index():
    """{имя res: запись прохода fb.scan} — для сеток голов и волос (один проход по каталогу)."""
    global _res
    if _res is None:
        import glob
        import json
        _res = {}
        key = '"k": "res"'
        for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(CAT, "scan", "*.jsonl"))):
            with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    if key in line and "/head/licensed/" in line and '"ofs"' in line:
                        r = json.loads(line)
                        _res.setdefault(r["name"], r)
    return _res


def mesh(name):
    """MeshSet → {'bbox', 'sections': {имя: {'nv', 'ntri', 'tri', атрибуты по USAGE}}} (LOD0)."""
    from .extract import cas_file, chunks
    r = _res_index().get(name)
    if r is None:
        raise KeyError(f"нет res {name}")
    d, _ = cas.read_entry(cas_file(r["cas"]), r["ofs"], r["size"])
    meta = bytes.fromhex(r["meta"])
    hdr, inline = struct.unpack_from("<II", meta, 0)
    lod = struct.unpack_from("<Q", d, 0x20)[0]
    nsec, sec_ptr = struct.unpack_from("<II", d, lod + 0x08)
    ib_size, vb_size = struct.unpack_from("<II", d, lod + 0x58)
    cid = str(uuid.UUID(bytes_le=bytes(d[lod + 0x60:lod + 0x70])))
    if inline:
        data = d[hdr:]
    else:
        c = chunks().get(cid)
        if not c or c.get("missing"):
            raise KeyError(f"{name}: нет чанка {cid}")
        if c.get("toc"):
            data = cas.read_stored(cas_file(c["cas"]), c["ofs"], c["csize"])
        else:
            data, _ = cas.read_entry(cas_file(c["cas"]), c["ofs"], (c["lo"] or 0) + c["ls"])
    vb = data[:vb_size]
    ib = np.frombuffer(data[vb_size:vb_size + ib_size], dtype="<u2")
    out = {"bbox": struct.unpack_from("<8f", d, 0), "sections": {}}
    for k in range(nsec):
        s = sec_ptr + k * SECTION_STEP
        nmp = struct.unpack_from("<Q", d, s + 0x08)[0]
        sname = d[nmp:d.index(b"\0", nmp)].decode("latin1")
        ntri, first, voff, nv = struct.unpack_from("<4I", d, s + 0x20)
        elems = []
        for e in range(16):
            usage, fmt, ofs, stream = struct.unpack_from("4B", d, s + 0x4C + 4 * e)
            if usage and stream != 0xFF:
                elems.append((usage, fmt, ofs, stream))
        nstreams = max(e[3] for e in elems) + 1
        strides = struct.unpack_from(f"<{nstreams}H", d, s + 0x8C)
        starts, acc = [], voff
        for st in strides:
            starts.append(acc)
            acc += st * nv
        sec = {"nv": nv, "ntri": ntri, "tri": ib[first:first + 3 * ntri].reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.int64)}
        for usage, fmt, ofs, stream in elems:
            if fmt not in FMT:
                continue
            dt, n = FMT[fmt]
            st = strides[stream]
            raw = np.frombuffer(vb, dtype=np.uint8, count=st * nv, offset=starts[stream]).reshape(nv, st)
            sec[USAGE.get(usage, hex(usage))] = raw[:, ofs:ofs + np.dtype(dt).itemsize * n].copy().view(dt).reshape(
                nv, n).astype(np.float64)
        out["sections"][sname] = sec
    return out


def head(folder):
    return mesh(f"{LICENSED}/{folder}/components/head_{folder}_mesh")


def hair(folder, variant="default_nomask"):
    """[(имя, секция)] сеток волос: base (шапка + пряди) и top (пряди); нет сетки — пропускается."""
    out = []
    for part in ("base", "top"):
        try:
            m = mesh(f"{LICENSED}/{folder}/components/hair_{folder}_{variant}_{part}_mesh")
        except KeyError:
            continue
        out += [(f"{part}:{k}", v) for k, v in m["sections"].items()]
    return out


def _tex_index():
    global _tex
    if _tex is None:
        _tex = {}
        with open(os.path.join(CAT, "textures.csv"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for r in csv.DictReader(f):
                if "/head/licensed/" in r["name"] and r["ofs"] and r["name"] not in _tex:
                    _tex[r["name"]] = r
    return _tex


def tex(name, mip=0):
    """Текстура по имени res → RGBA uint8 (H, W, 4)."""
    from .extract import read_chunk, read_header
    r = _tex_index().get(name)
    if r is None:
        raise KeyError(f"нет текстуры {name}")
    h = read_header(r)
    data, start = read_chunk(h)
    if data is None:
        raise KeyError(f"{name}: нет чанка")
    img = texture.decode_mip(h, data, max(mip, start), data_first=start)
    return np.array(img.convert("RGBA"))


def head_textures(folder):
    t = f"{LICENSED}/{folder}/textures"
    try:
        hair = tex(f"{t}/hair_{folder}_color")
    except KeyError:                       # без волос (лысый) — текстуры нет
        hair = None
    return {"head": tex(f"{t}/head_{folder}_color"), "hair": hair}
```

`tools/fb/helmet.py`:

```py
"""Наклейки на шлем (спонсор или логотип) NHL 24 → NHL Legacy: rendering/logo/texlib_<art>_1_<вариант>.rx2. Офлайн.

NHL 24: content/character/skater/league/nhl/<клуб>/adidas/<форма>/helmetlogo_adidas_<клуб>_<форма>_0_color
(1024×512, прозрачный фон; у SEA — Amazon). Legacy: растр logo_<A>_1_<V>_0 (256×128 DXT5) — наклейка по центру
(128; 58,5), рамка около 102×81 (docs/uniforms.md); растры _1 (128×64) и _2 (128×128) у EA пустые. Наклейка из NHL 24
вписывается в рамку по альфе с сохранением пропорций. Шлем грузит наклейку только при stockteamjerseys.helmetlogo = 1
(флаг ставит legacy-data).

  python -m fb.helmet build     # -> pack/cache/rendering/logo/…, pack/new/<КОД>_<метка>/helmet_logo_0.png, _parts/helmet.json
  python -m fb.helmet sheet     # -> compare/helmet_logos.png (Legacy сейчас | из NHL 24)
"""
import argparse
import csv
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

from .cas import REPO
from .kit_batch import ADIDAS, CLUBS, NHL24, legacy_target
from .pack import CACHE, PACK, TOOLS, legacy_has, md5, save_part

SRC = os.path.join(NHL24, "extract", "helmet24")
FRAME = (176, 88)   # по замерам 152 наклеек EA в Legacy: квадратные ~89×86, широкие ~159×44, максимум 192×109
CENTER = (127.5, 58.0)
EXCLUDE = {"ARI": "ARI → Utah, не ставить"}
# шаблон файла под новый номер — по длине «A_1_V» (имена растров logo_A_1_V_k переписываются на месте, длина та же):
# 6_1_0 → texlib_0_1_0, 6_1_10 и 10_1_0 → texlib_10_1_0, 127_1_0 → texlib_127_1_0
TEMPLATES = {5: "rendering/logo/texlib_0_1_0.rx2", 6: "rendering/logo/texlib_10_1_0.rx2",
             7: "rendering/logo/texlib_127_1_0.rx2"}


def template_for(art, variant):
    """-> (свой файл Legacy или None, файл-шаблон)."""
    have = legacy_has(f"rendering/logo/texlib_{art}_1_{variant}.rx2")
    return have, have or legacy_has(TEMPLATES[len(f"{art}_1_{variant}")])


def decal(club, kit):
    n = f"content/character/skater/league/nhl/{club}/adidas/{kit}/helmetlogo_adidas_{club}_{kit}_0_color"
    with open(os.path.join(SRC, "_index.csv"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in csv.DictReader(f):
            if r["name"] == n and r["status"] == "ok":
                return Image.open(os.path.join(SRC, r["png"])).convert("RGBA")
    return None


def fit(img):
    """Вписать по альфе в рамку FRAME с центром CENTER на холсте 256×128."""
    a = np.asarray(img)[..., 3]
    ys, xs = np.nonzero(a > 16)
    out = Image.new("RGBA", (256, 128), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    if len(xs) == 0:
        return None
    crop = img.crop((xs.min(), ys.min(), xs.max() + 1, ys.max() + 1))
    s = min(FRAME[0] / crop.size[0], FRAME[1] / crop.size[1])
    nw, nh = max(1, round(crop.size[0] * s)), max(1, round(crop.size[1] * s))
    crop = crop.resize((nw, nh), Image.LANCZOS)
    out.alpha_composite(crop, (int(round(CENTER[0] - nw / 2)), int(round(CENTER[1] - nh / 2))))
    return out


def write_logo(tpl_path, art, variant, logo, out_path):
    sys.path.insert(0, TOOLS)
    import teamart as ta
    rw = ta.Rw4.load(tpl_path)
    import re
    for i, (sp, ln) in enumerate(rw.name_slots):  # logo_<A>_1_<V>_k целиком: арт и вариант могут поменять длину
        s = rw.raw[sp:sp + ln].decode("latin1")     # по отдельности (10_1_0 → 6_1_10), общая длина — та же
        t = re.sub(r"^logo_\d+_1_\d+_", f"logo_{art}_1_{variant}_", s)
        if len(t) != len(s):
            raise ValueError(f"{art}_1_{variant}: длина имени растра меняется ({s}) — нужен шаблон той же длины")
        rw.raw[sp:sp + ln] = t.encode("latin1")
        if i < len(rw.textures):
            rw.textures[i].name = t
    for i, t in enumerate(rw.textures):
        lv = t.layout.levels
        w, h = lv[0][:2]
        src = logo if i == 0 else Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        if src.size != (w, h):
            src = src.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
        levels = []
        for L in lv:
            lw, lh = L[:2]
            im = src if (lw, lh) == src.size else src.resize((lw, lh), Image.BOX)
            levels.append((lw, lh, im.tobytes()))
        rw.replace(t, levels)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(out_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(rw.bytes())
    return [t.name for t in rw.textures]


def cmd_build(a):
    entries = []
    for club, art, code in CLUBS:
        for kit, label, loc in ADIDAS:
            img = decal(club, kit)
            if img is None:
                continue
            logo = fit(img)
            if logo is None:  # пустая наклейка (у twentythree часто) — пропуск
                continue
            tgt = legacy_target(art, loc)
            if code in EXCLUDE:
                entries.append({"type": "наклейка на шлем", "club": code, "kit": label, "action": "excluded",
                                "reason": EXCLUDE[code]})
                continue
            if not tgt:
                odir = os.path.join(PACK, "new", f"{code}_{label}")
                os.makedirs(odir, exist_ok=True)
                p = os.path.join(odir, "helmet_logo_0.png")
                logo.save(p)
                entries.append({"type": "наклейка на шлем", "club": code, "kit": label, "file": f"new/{code}_{label}/helmet_logo_0.png",
                                "action": "add_new (растр logo_<арт>_1_<вариант>_0, 256×128; номер назначит legacy-data)",
                                "md5": md5(p), "size": os.path.getsize(p), "db": "helmetlogo = 1"})
                continue
            v = tgt["variant"]
            rel = f"rendering/logo/texlib_{art}_1_{v}.rx2"
            have, tpl = template_for(art, v)
            names = write_logo(tpl, art, v, logo, os.path.join(CACHE, rel))
            entries.append({"type": "наклейка на шлем", "club": code, "kit": label, "file": rel,
                            "action": "replace" if have else "add",
                            "md5": md5(os.path.join(CACHE, rel)), "size": os.path.getsize(os.path.join(CACHE, rel)),
                            "rasters": names, "db": "stockteamjerseys.helmetlogo = 1",
                            "template": os.path.relpath(tpl, REPO).replace("\\", "/")})
            print(code, label, "->", rel, "replace" if have else "add (новый файл)", flush=True)
    save_part("helmet", entries)


def cmd_sheet(a):
    sys.path.insert(0, TOOLS)
    import teamart as ta
    try:
        font = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeui.ttf", 15)
    except OSError:
        font = ImageFont.load_default()
    with open(os.path.join(PACK, "_parts", "helmet.json"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        ent = json.load(f)
    W, H = 256, 128
    cols = 3
    rows = (len(ent) + cols - 1) // cols
    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (cols * (2 * W + 30), rows * (H + 30) + 10), (60, 64, 70))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for i, e in enumerate(ent):
        x = (i % cols) * (2 * W + 30) + 10
        y = (i // cols) * (H + 30) + 10
        d.text((x, y), f"{e['club']} {e['kit']}: Legacy сейчас | из NHL 24 ({e['action'][:9]})", fill=(240, 240, 240),
               font=font)
        if e.get("action") == "excluded":
            d.text((x + 10, y + 50), e["reason"], fill=(240, 150, 150), font=font)
            continue
        cur = legacy_has(e["file"]) if e["file"].startswith("rendering/") else None
        if cur:
            rw = ta.Rw4.load(cur)
            w, h, rgba = rw.decode(rw.textures[0])
            sheet.paste(Image.alpha_composite(Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (110, 110, 110, 255)),
                                              Image.frombytes("RGBA", (w, h), bytes(rgba))).convert("RGB"), (x, y + 20))
        newp = os.path.join(CACHE, e["file"]) if e["file"].startswith("rendering/") else os.path.join(PACK, e["file"])
        if newp.endswith(".rx2"):
            rw = ta.Rw4.load(newp)
            w, h, rgba = rw.decode(rw.textures[0])
            im = Image.frombytes("RGBA", (w, h), bytes(rgba))
        else:
            im = Image.open(newp).convert("RGBA")
        sheet.paste(Image.alpha_composite(Image.new("RGBA", im.size, (110, 110, 110, 255)), im).convert("RGB"),
                    (x + W + 10, y + 20))
    out = os.path.join(NHL24, "compare", "helmet_logos.png")
    sheet.save(out)
    print(out, sheet.size)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("build")
    sub.add_parser("sheet")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    return {"build": cmd_build, "sheet": cmd_sheet}[a.cmd](a)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

`tools/fb/ice.py`:

```py
"""Центр льда NHL 24 → формат NHL Legacy (centerlogo_<art>_cm, 1024²) для 32 клубов. Только офлайн.

У NHL 24 (content/worlds/rink/textures/centerlogo/ice_centerlogo_<N>_color, 1024² BC7, N — номер клуба EA) и у EA в
Legacy одна геометрия круга: синее кольцо r ≈ 380 на 1024² (NHL 24 r 377–383, цвет 0,50,160; Legacy 380,5–385,5,
0,56,165). Основа Legacy (как у EA, docs/logos-arenas.md): диск льда (231,233,231) r ≤ 388, кольцо, полоса x 494–529
прозрачная (под ней красная линия ice_cline). Поверх основы — картинка NHL 24 как есть (логотип и надпись арены за
кольцом; ляжет ли надпись за диском r > 388 в игре — проверить в игре).

  python -m fb.ice build         -> game/work/nhl24/out/ice/centerlogo_<КОД>.png (+ _onice.png — превью на льду)
  python -m fb.ice sheet         -> game/work/nhl24/compare/ice_center_32.png (Legacy сейчас | NHL 24 → Legacy)
"""
import argparse
import os
import subprocess
import sys

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

from .cas import REPO
from .kit_batch import CLUBS

NHL24 = os.path.join(REPO, "game", "work", "nhl24")
SRC = os.path.join(NHL24, "extract", "ice", "worlds", "rink", "textures", "centerlogo")
OUT = os.path.join(NHL24, "out", "ice")
LEGACY_BIG = os.path.join(REPO, "game", "other", "legacy", "big")
OURS = os.path.join(REPO, "game", "work", "legacy-data", "out", "rendering", "icesurface")
EA_INDEX = {"vegas": 32, "seattle": 33}  # у остальных номер EA = artid Legacy (0…29)
H = 1024


def legacy_base():
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:H]
    r = np.hypot(xx - 511.5, yy - 511.5)
    base = np.zeros((H, H, 4))
    base[r <= 388] = [231, 233, 231, 255]
    base[(r >= 380.5) & (r <= 385.5)] = [0, 56, 165, 255]
    return base, r


def convert(n24):
    base, r = legacy_base()
    a = n24[..., 3:4] / 255.0
    out = base.copy()
    out[..., :3] = base[..., :3] * (1 - a) + n24[..., :3] * a
    out[..., 3] = np.maximum(base[..., 3], n24[..., 3])
    stripe = np.zeros((H, H), dtype=bool)
    stripe[:, 494:530] = True
    out[..., 3] = np.where(stripe & (r <= 388), 0, out[..., 3])
    return out


def on_ice(img):
    ice = np.zeros((H, H, 3))
    ice[:] = [226, 230, 232]
    ice[:, 494:530] = [200, 30, 40]
    a = img[..., 3:4] / 255.0
    return Image.fromarray((ice * (1 - a) + img[..., :3] * a).astype(np.uint8))


def legacy_current(art):
    """Нынешний центр льда Legacy: наш (SEA/VGK — game/work/legacy-data/out) или из архивов игры."""
    rel = os.path.join("rendering", "icesurface", f"centerlogo_{art}_cm.rx2")
    for p in [os.path.join(OURS, f"centerlogo_{art}_cm.rx2")] + [os.path.join(LEGACY_BIG, d, rel) for d in
                                                                 sorted(os.listdir(LEGACY_BIG))]:
        if os.path.exists(p):
            png = os.path.join(OUT, "_legacy", f"centerlogo_{art}.png")
            if not os.path.exists(png):
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(png), exist_ok=True)
                subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(REPO, "tools", "teamart.py"), "decode", p, png],
                               check=True, capture_output=True)
            return np.asarray(Image.open(png).convert("RGBA")).astype(np.float64)
    return None


def cmd_build(a):
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    for club, art, code in CLUBS:
        n = EA_INDEX.get(club, art)
        p = os.path.join(SRC, f"ice_centerlogo_{n}_color.png")
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            print(code, "нет чанка")
            continue
        img = convert(np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert("RGBA")).astype(np.float64))
        Image.fromarray(img.astype(np.uint8)).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"centerlogo_{code}.png"))
        on_ice(img).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"centerlogo_{code}_onice.png"))
        print(code, f"NHL 24 #{n} -> centerlogo_{art}_cm")


def cmd_sheet(a):
    try:
        font = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeuib.ttf", 18)
    except OSError:
        font = ImageFont.load_default()
    S, cols, pad, top = 210, 4, 10, 26
    rows = (len(CLUBS) + cols - 1) // cols
    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (cols * (2 * S + 3 * pad), rows * (S + top + pad) + pad), (30, 30, 34))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for i, (club, art, code) in enumerate(CLUBS):
        x = pad + (i % cols) * (2 * S + 3 * pad)
        y = pad + (i // cols) * (S + top + pad)
        d.text((x, y), f"{code}: Legacy сейчас  |  из NHL 24", fill=(235, 235, 235), font=font)
        cur = legacy_current(art)
        if cur is not None:
            sheet.paste(on_ice(cur).resize((S, S), Image.LANCZOS), (x, y + top))
        newp = os.path.join(OUT, f"centerlogo_{code}_onice.png")
        if os.path.exists(newp):
            sheet.paste(Image.open(newp).resize((S, S), Image.LANCZOS), (x + S + pad, y + top))
        else:
            d.text((x + S + pad + 20, y + top + S // 2), "нет чанка", fill=(220, 130, 130), font=font)
    out = os.path.join(NHL24, "compare", "ice_center_32.png")
    sheet.save(out)
    print(out, sheet.size)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("build")
    sub.add_parser("sheet")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    return {"build": cmd_build, "sheet": cmd_sheet}[a.cmd](a)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```
